independence.authorship_method: Thirty independently specified semantic families manually authored, each parameterized over all five authoritative scopes. No optimization against candidate behavior.
normative_clarifications_from_parent_onl: Native scalar and list types, mask vocabulary, typed notice decision, and unresolved-value omission were supplied without candidate outputs.
Whole-word searchable-text negatives cover normalized title, authors, subjects, and description using non-word boundaries.
Native title_text matches title OR author text; authored gold preserves that contract and makes no bibliography-identity assertion.
independence.topology_function: Exact supplied pure C2 source executed unchanged in isolated namespace.

normative_uncertainties: The brief does not prescribe a wire schema for preference or notice objects; explicit self-describing structured objects are used.
Spelling corrections are independent judgments of unique canonical repair, not observed parser behavior.
No execution was used to establish how unsupported or incomplete requests expose partial resolved operands; gold asserts normative meanings and applicability independently.

revision_provenance.feedback_received: Rejected identifiers and collision fact only; no sealed contents, predictions, outcomes, or acceptance target rates.
revision_provenance.replacement_semantics: Unresolved mandatory rating comparison direction at a fully supplied inclusive boundary, rather than single-author choice.
revision_provenance.trigger: Established sealed structural auditor reported operation-topology collision in exactly five COMP3-F11-<scope> rows before any prediction capture.

schema_conventions.absence: Every known absent scalar/list/bool asserted as None/[]/False with APPLICABLE_ABSENCE.
schema_conventions.availability: AVAILABLE_NOW for mandatory available-now tenant requests; Global availability is explicitly advisory.
schema_conventions.formats: formats/exclusive_formats/excluded_formats are string lists. ONLINE only asserts ONLINE in both formats and exclusive_formats.
schema_conventions.notices: Canonical spelling correction carries raw and canonical operands plus source authority, independently of field gold.
schema_conventions.partial_lists: Resolved common values retained with PARTIALLY_APPLICABLE and explicit alternatives in unadapted_mandatory_assertions.
schema_conventions.preferences: Structured field/relation/value/mandatory=false objects, preserved separately from hard constraints.
schema_conventions.unadapted_assertions: Unsupported, missing, alternative, association, repair, and contradictory requirements are preserved without forcing them into native fields.
schema_conventions.unknown: Mandatory unresolved fields omitted from expected_hard_constraints, explicit UNRESOLVED applicability mask without a resolved_value.
